sharedSource.sourceFinding: The pinned Hungarian Wikipedia revision identifies the Debrecen–Nagykereki railway as MÁV line 106 and explicitly lists Debrecen in its route diagram and service table. It cites Magyar Vasúttörténet volumes 2 and 4, independent railway publications and press; no VPE/HÜSZ/KTI/GYSEV source lineage was found.
sharedSource.caveat: The individual route row does not carry a separate inline citation; this limitation is disclosed for human review.
